display.purpose: Hero headline only — the one loud moment per page.

title.purpose: Doc page titles and card headings.

lede.purpose: Hero subhead and section intros, capped near 540px.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, group labels, meta, pills, kbd — machine layer only.

shadows.name: resting-hairline
shadows.purpose: Barely-there lift for subtly raised controls.

shadows.name: floating-surface
shadows.purpose: Cmd-K search palette, dropdowns, popovers. Reserved for genuinely floating UI.

motion.name: ease-state
motion.purpose: Default transition for color, border-color, and opacity on interactive elements.

motion.name: backdrop-blur-nav
motion.purpose: Sticky nav legibility over scrolling content. Sanctioned glass, not decoration.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion alternative — applied globally to all animation/transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The confident inverted block; one true CTA per region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(22% 0.02 240); color: oklch(98.5% 0.004 250); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(22% 0.02 240); cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.88; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(55% 0.16 145); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(100% 0 0); color: oklch(22% 0.02 240); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 240); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: oklch(82% 0.012 240); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(55% 0.16 145); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Green-tinted call-to-action; the accent's rare appearance.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(96% 0.04 145); color: oklch(28% 0.10 145); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklab, oklch(55% 0.16 145) 30%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { border-color: oklch(55% 0.16 145); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(55% 0.16 145); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Pill
components.description: Mono status tag with optional leading dot; accent variant shown.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 22px; padding: 0 8px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.01em; background: oklch(97.5% 0.005 240); color: oklch(36% 0.02 240); border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 240); } .ds-pill .ds-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; } .ds-pill-accent { color: oklch(28% 0.10 145); background: oklch(96% 0.04 145); border-color: color-mix(in oklab, oklch(55% 0.16 145) 25%, transparent); }

components.name: Callout (Info)
components.description: Signature tinted block: icon + content, full border, single sanctioned 3px left accent.
components.html: Heads up. This is the one surface allowed a colored left stripe.
components.css: .ds-callout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 20px 1fr; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 240); border-left: 3px solid oklch(62% 0.13 240); border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(96% 0.03 240); color: oklch(36% 0.02 240); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-callout > svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; color: oklch(62% 0.13 240); margin-top: 1px; } .ds-callout strong { color: oklch(22% 0.02 240); font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Inline Code
components.css: .ds-code { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.92em; padding: 1px 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: oklch(97.5% 0.005 240); border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 240); color: oklch(22% 0.02 240); }

components.name: GitHub Stars Widget
components.description: Split pill: label segment + mono tabular count that flips to accent once loaded.
components.css: .ds-gh { display: inline-flex; align-items: stretch; height: 32px; border: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 240); border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(97.5% 0.005 240); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; overflow: hidden; } .ds-gh-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 0 10px; color: oklch(36% 0.02 240); } .ds-gh-label svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; } .ds-gh-count { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px; background: oklch(96% 0.04 145); color: oklch(28% 0.10 145); font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; border-left: 1px solid oklch(90% 0.008 240); } .ds-gh-count::before { content: '★'; margin-right: 4px; color: oklch(70% 0.14 75); }

components.name: Cmd-K Search Result
components.description: A row in the floating search palette; mono name + muted description, 44px min.
components.html: /phx:planPlan a feature across domains
components.css: .ds-search-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 6px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; } .ds-search-item:hover, .ds-search-item:focus-visible { background: oklch(97.5% 0.005 240); outline: 0; } .ds-search-name { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; color: oklch(22% 0.02 240); } .ds-search-desc { color: oklch(52% 0.018 240); font-size: 12px; overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; text-overflow: ellipsis; }

narrative.overview: phxagents.dev reads like a well-set engineering field manual: a practitioner's reference with strong, stated rules, dense information laid out for fast scanning, and zero ornament that doesn't carry meaning. The product it sells is enforced discipline (the Iron Laws, named specialist agents), so the site itself must look engineered, not decorated. The system is tech-utility: a near-white, faintly blue-tinted neutral canvas; a single green signal accent that earns its rare appearances; monospace reserved for the machine layer; and a type scale that gets genuinely large at the hero and stays tight and quiet everywhere else. It explicitly rejects the AI-marketing house style — no warm cream backgrounds, no gradient-text headlines, no decorative glassmorphism, no hero-metric template, no per-section eyebrows, nothing playful or mascot-driven. Warmth and credibility come from precision and specificity.
keyCharacteristics: Dense, signal-first layout; whitespace earns its place rather than padding for elegance.
One green accent (145 degrees) used sparingly; violet (295 degrees) as a secondary signal only.
Inter for everything readable, JetBrains Mono for everything machine (commands, counts, labels, code).
Flat-by-default surfaces: 1px borders + tonal layering, shadows only on floating UI.
First-class light and dark themes; both pass WCAG 2.2 AA independently.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Green is the only brand accent and appears on <=10% of any screen. If two things are green, neither reads as the action — pull one back to neutral.

rules.name: The Cool-Neutral Rule
rules.body: Neutrals are tinted toward blue (hue 240-250), never toward warm/cream. A beige or sand canvas is the AI-marketing tell this brand exists to avoid.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Machine Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for things that are literally code: commands, file paths, counts, version strings, kbd hints, labels. Mono as decorative developer flavor is forbidden.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Inter's weight and size contrast plus the mono/sans axis. Never introduce a second sans display face.

rules.name: The 75ch Rule
rules.body: Long-form prose caps at ~65-75ch measure; the lede caps near 540px. Full-width body text is forbidden in reading columns.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest: borders + tonal fills do the separating. A shadow only appears when an element genuinely floats above the page or as a hover/focus response.

dos: Do keep green to <=10% of any screen (The One Signal Rule).
Do tint neutrals toward blue (hue 240-250), never toward warm/cream.
Do use JetBrains Mono only for machine content — commands, counts, paths, labels, kbd, code.
Do build depth from 1px borders + tonal surface layering; reserve shadows for floating UI.
Do keep prose at a 65-75ch measure and body at 14px; density is intentional.
Do verify 4.5:1 body contrast (3:1 large) in both light and dark themes, including placeholders.
Do show keyboard focus with the 2px accent :focus-visible ring, and ship a reduced-motion alternative for every animation.
donts: Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text over a gradient). The hero h1 em currently does this — it is design debt to remove, not a pattern to copy.
Don't use a warm SaaS-cream/beige/sand background, a hero-metric template, or an endless grid of identical icon + heading + text feature cards.
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively. Blur is only sanctioned for the sticky nav and the search overlay.
Don't put a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow above every section, or numbered 01/02/03 markers as default scaffolding.
Don't add side-stripe accents (border-left > 1px as the only accent) to cards, list items, or alerts. The callout is the single sanctioned exception.
Don't nest cards, and don't add resting shadows to cards.
Don't go playful — no emoji-as-decoration, bouncy/elastic motion, or mascots.
Don't imply any affiliation with the Phoenix Framework or commercial phoenix.new.
